chapters.title: Introduction to the Book
paragraphs: Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds, and blessings and peace be upon Muhammad, his family and companions, abundantly. This correct answer to whoever changed the religion of Christ has been set down as a defence of the religion of the messengers, and as a conviction that what Muhammad, peace be upon him, brought is the straight path.

chapters.title: Chapter: On the Prophethood of Muhammad, peace be upon him
paragraphs: The prophethood of Muhammad, peace be upon him, is evidenced by what cannot be counted of verses and reports in Scripture and Sunna; he is described in the Torah and the Gospel through his counterparts and analogues. Whoever reflects upon God's word finds in it the description of the final prophet, and that his message encompasses all the laws, sealing what came before and witnessing to it.

chapters.title: Chapter: Against Those Who Pretend to Reform the Religion
paragraphs: As for those who pretend to reform the religion while claiming a return to its origin, they are but imitators of those who altered the origin of the religion, and they have not realised that reform is a return to what the Messenger of God, peace be upon him, and his Companions were upon. The religion is well known to whoever understands it, and innovation is a misguidance to whoever is sensible of it.

chapters.title: Chapter: Encouraging the Pursuit of Sacred Knowledge
paragraphs: The pursuit of sacred knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim man and woman, because it is a precondition of the other obligations of worship and transactions. Whoever combines the Qur'an and jurisprudence in his breast, God opens for him a door of light and guides him by it to the benefits of this world and the next.
